lines.en: I open my stride and run fast.

lines.zh: 我的脖子一前一后地动。
lines.en: My neck pumps forward and back.
My feet slap the ground.

lines.zh: 我展开一点翅膀保持平衡。
lines.en: I spread my wings a little for balance.
I stride over a shrub.

lines.zh: 大长腿绕过石头，没减速。
lines.en: Long legs round the rock without slowing.
I'm light, and running doesn't tire me.
I race across the plain.
My feathers shiver in the wind.
I walk a while to rest.
I run from the sand to the grass edge.
I pick my way carefully.
Long legs, long strides.
I run into the wind.

lines.zh: 我沿着草原边缘跑了一圈。
lines.en: I run a lap along the edge of the meadow.
I run along the edge of the group.

lines.zh: 我大步跨过一丛矮灌木。
lines.en: I stride over a low bush.
I kick up a little dust.
I stand with my neck straight up.
I peck at small stones.

lines.zh: 我把脖子贴到草上听了听。
lines.en: I lay my neck against the grass and listen.
I preen my chest with my beak.
It's open here; I see far.
My legs ache a little.
I turn a slow circle.
The wind has ruffled my feathers.
I settle with my legs folded.

lines.zh: 我吞了几口沙粒，帮助消化。
lines.en: I swallow a few grains of sand to help digestion.

lines.zh: 我的长腿影子拖得很远。
lines.en: My long-legged shadow stretches far.
I wait for this gust to pass.
You're a bit shorter than me.

lines.zh: 我一条腿往前迈，又收回来。
lines.en: I step one leg forward, then draw it back.
Do you have melon?
You can't catch me at a run.
My legs are strong.
Don't stand directly behind me.
I'm sizing you up.
One stride of these long legs covers three.

lines.zh: 你手里的西瓜片我看见了。
lines.en: I have seen the melon slice in your hand.
Are you thinking of riding me?

lines.zh: 我的羽毛看着乱，其实不。
lines.en: My feathers look untidy, but they aren't.
I lower my head to look closer.
You're smiling. I don't follow.

lines.zh: 这里除了草，没有别的东西。
lines.en: Nothing here but grass.
Ran too fast — my leg's a bit lame.
My wings droop, crooked.
I back away, neck drawn in.
One of my legs can't hold.
My cry comes high and sharp.
I spread my wings to balance.

lines.zh: 我的脖子一伸一缩，喘着。
lines.en: My neck pumps in and out as I pant.

lines.zh: 你的准头比我以为的好。
lines.en: You aim better than I expected.
My legs still work. Don't rush.
I need to get further off.
That's melon, isn't it?
You raise the melon slice.
I go over on my long legs.
That sweetness. I like it.
I crane my long neck to sniff.

lines.zh: 那西瓜片的汁水滴在草上。
lines.en: Juice from that melon slice drips onto the grass.
I peck once, quickly.

lines.zh: 这点东西，我一下就吃完。
lines.en: I'll finish this in a moment.

lines.zh: 我伸着脖子，离你的手一寸。
lines.en: My neck stretches to an inch from your hand.
I won't peck your hand.

lines.zh: 我张开翅膀才没栽进草里。
lines.en: I spread my wings to keep from falling into the grass.
I spread my wings to steady.

lines.zh: 我的长脖子一低，绕开你。
lines.en: My long neck dips as I swerve around you.
Don't push; my legs are too long.
We collide and feathers fly.

lines.zh: 我抬起脚，单腿站了一会儿。
lines.en: I lift my foot and stand on one leg a moment.
I step back, neck still crooked.
That made me sway badly.
I lean on you and steady.

lines.zh: 我的腿太长，刹车要多几步。
lines.en: My legs are too long; braking takes a few strides.
Another runs up, fast.
Our necks touch.
Its feathers are darker than mine.

lines.zh: 两只鸵鸟同步迈着长腿。
lines.en: Two ostriches stride with their long legs in time.
It stops beside me.
We dip our heads at the same time.
Its legs are longer than mine.
We press our wings together.
There's an egg on the ground.
We run this plain together.
I peck up something.
I peck it up and tip my head back to swallow.
I tilt my head, look, and swallow.
Too hard. I drop it.
I scratch in the sand.
This shiny one is mine.
I trot off with it in my beak.
I pecked it, so it's mine.
I drop it. Don't care for it.
I won't forget this.
You pulled my feathers.

lines.zh: 我的脚趾抓紧草根，准备跑。
lines.en: My toes grip the grass roots, ready to run.
My legs are quickening.
On this plain I'm quick.

lines.zh: 我的长腿已经跨到你侧面。
lines.en: My long legs have already carried me to your flank.

lines.zh: 我低低地叫了一声，警告你。
lines.en: I give a low call to warn you.
I spread my wings for balance.

lines.zh: 你拽我羽毛的事我记着。
lines.en: I remember you pulling my feathers.
This time I won't run.

lines.zh: 我这么轻，水里也不会沉。
lines.en: Light as I am, I don't sink.
I run behind you.
Wherever you run, I keep up.
My strides are longer than yours.

lines.zh: 我刹住脚，扬起一片尘土。
lines.en: I skid to a stop, kicking up dust.
There are no obstacles on this plain.

lines.zh: 我的头在奔跑时一上一下。
lines.en: My head bobs up and down as I run.

lines.zh: 我跨一步，就把你甩在后面。
lines.en: One stride leaves you behind.
I'm not tired yet.
A little more and you'll slow.
I close in, slowly.
I kick out.
That kick landed solidly.
I hammer your hand with my beak.
You pull back; I follow two steps.
I run into you.
That kick knocked you sideways.
I leap and kick out.
You've caught my leg.
I wrench myself free.
I back a few paces, panting.

lines.zh: 草原上出现一个高高的影子。
lines.en: A tall shape appears on the plain.
I run out of the heat shimmer.

lines.zh: 我站起来，比草丛高出一大截。
lines.en: I stand, a head taller than the tall grass.

lines.zh: 沙地上多了一串大脚印。
lines.en: Big prints join the sand.

lines.zh: 我一步跨出去，比马还远。
lines.en: One stride outruns a horse.
I stand taller than anything around.
Open ground. Very good.
I raise my head and test the wind.
I slow to a stop.
I stand at the tallest grass.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的羽毛，很快烧起来。
lines.en: Fire catches my feathers and spreads fast.
I fall and my legs fold under me.

lines.zh: 我本该浮着，可这水太深。
lines.en: I should float, but this water is too deep.
The blast scatters my feathers.
An arrow grazes my neck.

lines.zh: 法术让我的腿一下软了。
lines.en: That spell turns my legs weak.
This plain is eaten out.
Thunder cracks and I bolt.
I'm falling and can't stop.
